record_under_review.evidence_span: HLSDebugger addresses HLS logic debugging with a released labeled dataset of about 300K samples and an encoder-decoder model that jointly predicts bug location, bug type, and correction; the abstract reports performance above advanced LLMs such as GPT-4 for bug identification and more than 3X for bug correction.
record_under_review.limits: The evidence is an author preprint; evaluation depends on the generated bug dataset and selected bug categories, and the repository has not yet extracted all accuracy, correction-validity, and generalization tables.
record_under_review.method_or_artifact: Open labeled HLS bug dataset and customized encoder-decoder LLM that performs multi-task bug-location identification, bug-type prediction, and code correction, optionally using HLS-tool information.
metrics: bug-identification performance above GPT-4 in reported evaluation
more than 3X bug-correction performance improvement over advanced LLMs
record_under_review.problem: HLS logic debugging is labor-intensive, circuit data is scarce, logic bugs are harder than syntax bugs, and reliable test cases are often unavailable.
record_under_review.title: HLSDebugger: Identification and Correction of Logic Bugs in HLS Code with LLM Solutions
record_under_review.workload_or_benchmark: HLS code containing known logic-bug categories, without assuming additional test cases.
